data.description: An athach can attack with its claw as a swift action, even when the creature's movement would normally restrict it to one attack.  This attack is made at a +%1 bonus and deals 1d10+%2 points of damage, regardless of what other attacks are made on the athach's turn.
data.name: Swift Claw
